set.body:
Journey: See. Track: engine and console.

Outcome
A researcher types words from a study's title or description on Home and finds it, if they are permitted to.

Acceptance
1. Home has one search box over the catalog records the caller may see (SEE2). A steward and an authorized reader find the protocol archive using words that occur only in its description. A BIDS study is found the same way.
2. A caller who holds only R1 sees R1's record. Text that exists only in R2 or in a hidden project never changes that caller's results, counts or page boundaries.
3. Results show title, custodian, data types and the caller's access (can read, or listed only), and open the study page.
4. An empty query, no match, and access that has expired each have a clear outcome in the browser.

Not in scope
Facets. Ranking beyond a sensible default. The paging defect ARC03, unless search paging turns out to depend on it.

Start from
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/Directory.scala.
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js, homeView.

Evidence
An integration test against a reference oracle, including two deposits with the same title and a private description that must not leak. A browser step in SEE8.
set.title: SEE3: Find a study from Home by its description (was ARC04)
